name: Telegram
description: Send Telegram messages and stored artifacts through a bot.

defaultChatId.title: Default chat id
defaultChatId.description: Chat used when a call gives no chat_id. Always an allowed destination; with no default and an empty allowedChatIds list the pack sends nowhere.

allowedChatIds.title: Allowed chat ids
allowedChatIds.description: Chat ids (numeric, or @username) this pack may send to besides the default chat. Empty (the default) means only the default chat. This pack reads every library artifact (library: read-all), so this list is what keeps artifacts inside chats you own. Agents cannot change this setting.
